correctness.rationale: At \(z=1\) the extra factor \(x+y+1\) is a unit. The four remaining branches are smooth; direct substitutions give five pairwise intersection multiplicities \(1\) and one equal to \(2\), yielding \(\delta=7\) and \(\mu=11\). Two explicit blowups give exceptional multiplicities \(4\) and \(6\) and valencies \(3\), so A'Campo gives the displayed degree-\(11\) characteristic polynomial. Exact saturation of the Tjurina ideal isolates the origin and has leading monomials \(x^3,x^2y,xy^3,y^6\), giving length \(10\). The packaged verifier recomputes these exact checks.
